programme.desc: In our previous episode, we visited various countries starting from Brazil. The 2025 Wingfoil Racing World Cup roared back to life on Brazil’s north-east coast, launching its season finale. In this episode, sailors from around the world have gathered for the inaugural World Sailing Inclusion Championships, racing in one of the most stunning coastal destinations on the planet: Oman. We have a full season of sailing action ahead of us, but 2025 was also filled with spectacle from around the world. With kiteboarding now inducted to the Olympic Games since Paris 2024, watching the latest developments in the class was a ‘must’ for Inside Sailing.

programme.title: The First Second - Armel Le Cl ac h E
programme.desc: Armel Le Cléach creates his victories thanks to a strong relationship with the whole team of which he is the extension ... But for this navigator engaged in a daunting battle with the ocean on a giant 32-meter trimaran, each course towards a new start is a new battle with the unknown, with his own will and with his primary adversary: himself.

programme.title: The First Second - Samantha Davies
programme.desc: Samantha Davies sees the ocean as a pleasure, obvious. In symbiosis with her boat, she leads a violent struggle with the harsh conditions and "loves it" in an almost inexplicable way! She knows and enjoys her luck, which she shares with Initiatives Cœur. She also measures it to that of her grandfather, a war submariner…. At the start of a race like the Vendée Globe, it is an adventurer who sets off.

programme.desc: From award-winning documentary filmmaker Carl Eneroth at Sthlm Social Innovation Lab comes "All the Way". A heart-pounding, intimate and mind expanding portrait of Swimrun team Pontus Lindberg and George Bjälkemo, as they prepare for their ultimate challenge… winning the 75 km ÖtillÖ Swimrun World Championships in the Stockholm archipelago… in trail shoes and a wetsuit.

programme.desc: Twenty teams from 12 countries would compete in the ninth Rolex New York Yacht Club Invitational Cup, the biennial regatta hosted by the New York Yacht Club Harbour Court in Newport, R.I. It does more than encapsulate stunning vistas and highlight the extraordinary New Zealand environment. It inspires people to be aware of the natural beauty that surrounds them.

With the season’s final stop still wide open, both athletes will need flawless performances to secure their third consecutive titles.

(Special Thanks to Pertex)

programme.title: A Feather in the West
programme.desc: In September 2019, a team of talented Irish climbers [Chloe Condron, Kevin Kilroy, Michelle OLoughlin and Conor McGovern] travelled to the small island of Owey to explore sea cliffs that local guidebook writer Iain Miller claims, have “enough new routing potential to last at least twelve lifetimes”. ‘A Feather in the West’ is a film about their trad climbing experiences and the relatively niche pursuit of first ascents, set on the Wild Atlantic Way, off the west coast of County Donegal. (Special thanks to Pertex)

programme.title: The Rise of the Hamminator Lindsey Hamm s journey from concrete to peaks
programme.desc: Mammut athlete Lindsey Hamm, a professional climber and mountain guide, brings a breath of fresh air to the world of mountaineering. Originally from Texas, she has begun making a name for herself in recent years. This short film offers a glimpse into her life, a recent expedition to Pakistan’s wild Charakusa Valley. Beyond the mountains, Lindsey is a people person, driven by a passion for inclusivity in climbing, and giving opportunities to other women, who want to get into the sport. She collaborates with womens organizations in Pakistan, helping to dismantle barriers and create opportunities for education and growth.

programme.title: Skiing China Exploring Altai Mountains
programme.desc: A quartet of champion skiers and snowboarders from Australia and the USA visit the unexplored Altai Frontier in China, now believed to be the place where skiing first developed, more than 10,000 years ago. They encounter the ancient culture of the region and explore the spectacular local slopes, using their own hi-tech equipment as well as the traditional skis manufactured by local craftsmen using age-old practices. The four visitors, Scott Kneller, Jari Hiatt, Halina Boyd and Harry Kearney, all of whom have world-beating careers in snowboarding, skiing and ski mountaineering, discover new challenges and new frontiers in China’s remote north-western province.

programme.title: Best Via Ferrata in the Julian Alps Eng
programme.desc: Just about an hours drive from Ljubljana airport, Prisojnik, or Prisank as its also called is a beautiful 2,547m mountain in Slovenias Julian Alps.This one-day via Ferrata route is a must-do since it presents an excellent hiking and climbing challenge, but also offers all of the views youd even want. To get to its summit Cris and Viv hiked, scrambled, climbed, and even crawled on their stomachs at points, but the views in the end and the feeling of satisfaction that came after made it all worthwhile.

programme.title: Aussie 8
programme.desc: Aussie 8 is the adventure of 3 friends who decided to climb the 8 tallest mountains in 8 Australian states in 8 days. To make this possible, they had to put together and respect a very strict timing and logistic organisation.

programme.title: Expedition Antarctica of extreme sports woman Caro North
programme.desc: Iceclimbing, ski mountaineering and sailing the open water for days through the infamous Drake Passage: The 28 years old extreme sports woman Caro North made her way to the very South of our continent for a four weeks expedition – accompanied by an eight-member crew. Antarctica turned out to be a paradise for extreme sports: deserted landscapes and snow-capped mountains against a surreal backdrop of ice and sea were waiting to be discovered.

programme.title: Climbing Skye s Highest Peak - Sgurr Alasdair
programme.desc: Cris and Viv decided to climb Sgurr Alasdair, the highest mountain on the island of Skye, located in an area of the mountain range known as Black Cullin. The main challenge they had in climbing the peak was the Great Stone Chute. A 300-meter slope of the harshest mountain terrain - scree. The summit of Sgurr Alasdair has unobstructed views of all of the Munroes in the Black Cullin, and also of one of Skyes most famous routes - The Cullin Ridge traverse.

programme.title: Nendaz Backcountry Invitational 2026
programme.desc: Nestled in the heart of the Swiss Alps, the Nendaz Backcountry Invitational by The North Face 2026 is one of the most exciting events on the freeride calendar. This unique competition brings together some of the world’s top backcountry athletes, showcasing their incredible skills and creativity in untouched snow.

programme.title: World Rookie Freeski Finals 2025
programme.desc: The World Rookie Tour is excited that the Freeski Finals are held in the magnificent Ursus Snowpark at Madonna di Campiglio. This event shows the world’s most talented young freeski athletes as they compete in one of the most celebrated snowparks in Europe. This exclusive opportunity brings the excitement and competitive spirit of one of the most anticipated events in youth action sports directly to athletes, fans and viewers.

programme.title: Raid Gallaecia 2025
programme.desc: In the frontier between Galicia and northern Portugal, adventure racing returned to one of Europe’s most unspoiled regions with Raid Gallaecia 2025. Over five days and nearly 500 kilometers, 28 international teams battled mountains, forests, rivers, and exhaustion in a non-stop race of strategy, endurance, and teamwork.

programme.title: Trans Sahara Marathon 2025
programme.desc: The Trans Sahara Marathon. Set against the breathtaking backdrop of the Sahara Desert, this epic race, held in February 2025, challenges runners to traverse 150 kilometers across four grueling stages of unforgiving terrain. Drawing the worlds top athletes from every corner of the globe, the Trans Sahara Marathon is more than just a race; its a testament to the boundless limits of human potential and the relentless pursuit of greatness.

programme.title: Ultra Gobi 2025 Eng
programme.desc: Each year, athletes from across the world gather in this remote wilderness og the Gobi desert for a test like no other. The 121-kilometer team challenge is where cooperation and strategy are everything, while the 121-kilometere solo adventure is a test for the braves. The legendary 400-kilometer race, a journey through solitude, extremes, and self-discovery. All together, they form one of the toughest endurance events on Earth.

programme.title: Ungrounded Episode 3 - Meredith Edwards
programme.desc: Meredith Edwards is an elite-level mountain ultra runner, with podium finishes at the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc TDS race, the Javelina Jundred 100K and the Flagstaff Skyrace 55K. She is also a member of the U.S. Ski Mountaineering Team. In Episode 3, she reveals how in 2019 she fought an inner struggle with her body that almost resulted in a full blood transfusion-and came back from it to win one of the world’s most challenging Ultra Marathons. (English version with French, German, Italian and Spanish subtitles available)

programme.title: The High
programme.desc: THE HIGH is a feature length documentary film about the making of the longest high altitude foot race in the world. The film follows the path of a group of extreme runners who individually decide to take part of a dangerous running experiment gone wrong. Indian race director Rajat Chauhan works against the advice of the military, his family and friends to create a race over the two highest passes in the world (above 17 500ft). The decline begins from the start, with runners collapsing from dehydration, hypothermia, and high-altitude sickness. And by its end finds the entire race in jeopardy and the prospect that no one finishes. Brought to life by archive footage, story recreations, and interviews, the film unfolds the events in the Himalayas of Northern India and gives a unique look into the lives of the extreme marathon runners involved. Uncovering the avalanches, athletes, and the high altitude elements. THE HIGH shows the rewards of determination, the dangers of obsession, and in the end leaves you with the answer of why they called it, the toughest race on earth. Directed by Barry Walton.

programme.title: Ungrounded Episode 3 - Meredith Edwards
programme.desc: Meredith Edwards is an elite-level mountain ultra runner, with podium finishes at the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc TDS race, the Javelina Jundred 100K and the Flagstaff Skyrace 55K. She is also a member of the U.S. Ski Mountaineering Team. In Episode 3, she reveals how in 2019 she fought an inner struggle with her body that almost resulted in a full blood transfusion-and came back from it to win one of the world’s most challenging Ultra Marathons. (English version with French, German, Italian and Spanish subtitles available)

programme.title: Challenge Family 2025 - Season Wrap Up Eng
programme.desc: Since its founding, the Challenge Family triathlon series has redefined the spirit of endurance sports. Known for its unique courses, passionate community, and athlete-centered values, Challenge Family offers races in some of the world’s most iconic locations. From the breathtaking landscapes to the demands of each event, Challenge Family is about more than just competition. It’s about athletes pushing beyond their limits, fueled by the support of fans, family, and each other. Through the journeys of athletes, everyone can understand what it takes to prepare, to overcome, and to race with a purpose that goes far beyond the finish line.

programme.title: UTMB KODIAK Ultra Marathon 2025
programme.desc: Two distances. One adventure. Feel the grit of the 50K, the madness of the 100K, and the shared passion that drives every runner forward. Dive into 45 minutes of raw trail energy. Relive the HOKA Kodiak Ultramarathons as if you were there.

programme.title: HOKA Chiang Mai Thailand by UTMB
programme.desc: The HOKA Chiang Mai Thailand by UTMB is the final of four UTMB World Series majors in 2025, offering athletes a great opportunity to progress towards the UTMB World Series Finals. Celebrating its 6th edition with new and improved courses along with an even deeper connection to Thailands natural and cultural heritage, the event attracts over 7,200 participants, including 56 from the Asia region and an exceptional elite field across all distances.

programme.title: Ungrounded Episode 3 - Meredith Edwards
programme.desc: Meredith Edwards is an elite-level mountain ultra runner, with podium finishes at the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc TDS race, the Javelina Jundred 100K and the Flagstaff Skyrace 55K. She is also a member of the U.S. Ski Mountaineering Team. In Episode 3, she reveals how in 2019 she fought an inner struggle with her body that almost resulted in a full blood transfusion-and came back from it to win one of the world’s most challenging Ultra Marathons. (English version with French, German, Italian and Spanish subtitles available)

programme.title: Florence Marathon - We run in art Eng
programme.desc: two select runners comment on their participation in the Florence marathon and the organizers provide unique insights on the Florence marathon.

programme.title: Cycling home from China Eng
programme.desc: Josh spent 4 months self filming his bike trip home from the Giant bike factory in Shanghai. During his 15 000 km trip between Shanghai China and Newcastle UK, he crossed 19 countries. A fantastic human adventure and a unique bike trip !

programme.title: The First Second - Michi Wohlleben
programme.desc: «The higher you raise the bar the further you fall down!”. Michi language is made of very strong, singular sentences, as sharpened as his climbing style. His sentences try to define himself, without worrying about himself, by thwarting clichés… but do not succeed in really finding himself. On the other hand his words create beautiful images that show Michis inspiration, fluidity, and pleasure in action. Through the discovery of his goals and his gamble with the risk, Michi mixes both quest and primal pleasure.

programme.title: UK Challenge 2025
programme.desc: Talent can win you the game, but its intelligence and teamwork that will win you the championship once, said the NBA basketball legend. That is Michael Jordan and hes right. And in this case, its the seven individual stages that are the games and the overall championship is the 2025 UK challenge. For the next three days and nights, nearly 70 teams will be putting themselves through what is the most mentally and physically demanding team building competition that youll see anywhere, and theyre all doing it for the challenge of building teamwork and the acclaim of picking up that overall Winners Trophy.

programme.title: The First Second - Geraldine Fasnacht
programme.desc: When Geraldine, the bird woman puts on her mask, we know that the images of the pink wingsuit will be closer to poetry than adrenaline! Several snowboard world championship titles, more than 3200 jumps, but at the start, how do you decide to ride and fly all your life?

programme.title: UIPM 2025 Obstacle World Championships
programme.desc: Beijing’s Olympic Centre turns into a proving ground as the UIPM Obstacle World Championships crown new stars across the 400 m, 3 K, and blistering 100 m sprint.

programme.title: The Outdoor Sports Show 2026 - Episode 1
programme.desc: We will start this episode with the Standard Chartered Singapore Marathon 2025 with over 55,000 runners from around 80 countries. We are then travelling to Spain for the Font Vella Lanzarote International Marathon. From Spain, we are catching a flight to neighboring Portugal to attend the end of the 2025 season of the TRITON World Series. Next we follow the 6th edition of HOKA Chiang Mai Thailand by UTMB. Then we move to Geneva for another edition of CHI Geneva, Rolex Grand Prix. Finally we move to Saudi Arabia for the 2025 FIBA Asia Cup.

programme.title: Stepdads The Sketch- Ep 1
programme.desc: When infidelity claims the life of Joanne Bates, her children Lisa and Stevie are left in the custody of her fiancé Mike and his brother Jerry. Mike, a straight-laced, hardworking accountant; and Jerry, a wild, unstable, womanizer were both former foster children and together they provide a unique balance of parenting skills for young Lisa and Stevie. - Step Dads starring Ben Sloane (R.I.P.D, Alpha House), Morocco Omari (Empire, 21 Bridges, Homeland, Chicago Fire), Jorie Binion (Chicago P.D) Charles Dunlap (Chicago Fire, Empire), and Jay Davis (Not Another Black Movie, Choke On That: The Series, Not Another Zombie Movie) is a comedy about two polar opposite foster brothers raising two children using non-traditional parenting methods while shedding a satirical light on the importance of adoption. We poke fun at some of the mishaps which comes along with the shock of being a new parent, but ultimately, we hope to spread awareness on adoption, the importance of having fathers and father-figures in the lives of young people, and having a familial loving environment. The moral of our story is that “No family is perfect, but every child deserves to be loved unconditionally, and raised in a reliable, stable support system.”

programme.title: Not Another Black Movie
programme.desc: Not Another Black Movie stars Damon Williams (Bad Boys of Comedy, Comic View, BET LIVE, The Tom Joyner Morning Show), Janet Hubert (The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air), Rodney Perry (The Monique Show, Who's Got Jokes) Jay Davis (Not Another Zombie Movie, Shots Fired), and Leon Rogers (WGCI, Comic View, Bad Boys of Comedy). - Not Another Black Movie is not only a spoof of a genre often associated with Tyler Perry films, but a satirical look at family dysfunction as well. Written by Jay Davis and Directed by Donte "Diesel" Williams, Not Another Black Movie addresses issues that effect many families whether they be rich or poor, black or white. Although we poke fun at some of the stereotypical roles portrayed in this genre, we hope to shed some light on problems that plague many families while giving you a good laugh.

programme.title: Car Crews with Supercar Blondie S1
programme.desc: Supercar Blondie krijgt toegang tot een exclusieve McClaren Senna van 2 miljoen dollar en gaat op onderzoek uit om meer te weten te komen over de benderuzies in de SLAB (Slow, Low en Bangin') gemeenschap en ze ontmoet legendarische hiphopartiesten Slim Thug en Paul Wall.

programme.title: Car Crews with Supercar Blondie S1
programme.desc: Supercar Blondie komt in een Lamborghini SVJ roadster aan in Las Vegas. Onder de vleugels van Patrick, oprichter van de Junkyard Pirates, wordt Alex meegenomen in de wereld van de rat rod: het thuis van de Amerikaanse mavericks en outsiders.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas S2
programme.desc: Vinnie en het team van Muscle Cars of Texas werken aan de frame-restauratie van een Corvette uit 1972. Van lelijk naar prachtig. De Ford pickup uit 1959 is klaar om terug te gaan naar de eigenaar. De Corvette Fuelie uit 1964 krijgt een nieuwe bumper.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas S2
programme.desc: De 63 Z06 krijgt extra glasvezelwerk aan de binnenkant. Vinnie vervangt de ramen van de 442 en plaatst de interne onderdelen in de deur. En we gaan naar Galveston voor de Galveston Corvette Show.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas S2
programme.desc: De zwarte Trans Am uit 1978 heeft een gloednieuwe motor en is klaar om voor het eerst gestart te worden. De “Malicious Intent”, een Mustang uit 1969, is klaar voor de spuiterij. De restauratie van de Corvette uit 1972 – van lelijk naar prachtig – zit nu in de stripproces.

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S1
programme.desc: De officiële perslancering van The Flying Kestrel op legendarische racebaan Santa Pod. Het team van Kestrel wordt vergezeld door Victor Riley van Riley Cars en beroemdheid Rachel Riley.

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S1
programme.desc: De dag van het record. De transformatie is voltooid en het is tijd om The Flying Kestrel op de proef te stellen. Maar is het team veel te ver gegaan?

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S1
programme.desc: De dag van het record. De transformatie is voltooid en het is tijd om The Flying Kestrel op de proef te stellen. Maar is het team veel te ver gegaan?

programme.title: Road to Gymkhana Grid
programme.desc: Road to Gymkhana Grid is een documentaire waarin de reis van acht wereldklasse coureurs door Zuid-Afrika wordt gevolgd om mee te doen aan de wereldwijde driftwedstrijd.

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S2
programme.desc: De rookies staan voor hun moeilijkste uitdaging tot nu toe, die zowel mentaal als fysiek een zware beproeving is. Vervolgens moeten ze al hun resterende krachten verzamelen om een tijdrit op een uithoudingscircuit te voltooien.

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S2
programme.desc: Het wordt serieus met een Super Motard-challenge, ontworpen om de offroad-, weg- en motocrossvaardigheden van de rookies te testen. Maar er is een twist: de jury heeft een nieuwe regel achter de hand die het spel volledig zal veranderen.

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S2
programme.desc: Na ongelooflijke hoogtepunten en hartverscheurende dieptepunten tijdens de competitie, zal slechts één rookie worden gekroond tot The Ultimate Rider.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S7

programme.desc: ‘Bas’ verwijst naar muziekinstrumenten met een lage toon. Paspoorten zijn essentieel voor internationale reizen. En wat zijn de functies van onze neus? Ook bloeddruk, bioscopen, frisdrank en strips komen aan bod.

programme.title: Space Greed S1
programme.desc: Zal het ooit nuttig zijn om de ruimte te gebruiken voor het dumpen van onze troep en afval?

programme.title: Space Greed S1
programme.desc: De miljardeninvesteringen voor ruimte-ontdekking door miljardairs zijn niet zonder reden, maar het is moeilijk om te negeren hoeveel geld er mogelijk te verdienen valt.

programme.title: Space Greed S1
programme.sub-title: Will Satellites Help Us Save or Exploit Earth?
programme.desc: Ons voortbestaan op deze planeet hangt op de lange termijn af van geavanceerde satellieten die ons verbonden houden en het mogelijk maken om de aarde en het klimaat in de gaten te houden.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1
programme.desc: Hoe lang duurt het voordat het leven zich herstelt na massale uitroeiing? Wetenschappers in Spitsbergen graven door fossiele aanwijzingen voor verrassende onthullingen over de geschiedenis van onze aarde.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1
programme.desc: Wetenschappelijke studies bevestigen dat de zeespiegel over de hele wereld verandert. Grote kuststeden zoals Miami vechten zich daarom terug tegen de stijgende getijden, voordat het te laat is. Delen van Miami Beach worden ernstig bedreigd, met grote economische gevolgen.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1
programme.desc: Door de ontdekking in 2013 van nieuwe en raadselachtige vondsten van fossielen met een kleine schedel van Homo naledi proberen wetenschappers te begrijpen of Homo sapiens in dezelfde tijd als Homo naledi leefde en hoe Homo naledi-gemeenschappen geleefd kunnen hebben.

programme.title: Rethink S1
programme.sub-title: Penrose Triangle and The Brain Illusion Pareidolia
programme.desc: In een wereld waar niets is wat het lijkt, bekijken we onmogelijke objecten zoals de Penrose-driehoek en de hersenillusie pareidolie, en verkennen we het fenomeen van levitatie.

programme.title: Rethink S1
programme.desc: We leggen optische illusies uit zoals geforceerd perspectief, introduceren de magie van Newtoniaanse vloeistoffen en duiken dieper in de truc met het magische spijkerbed.

programme.title: Rethink S1
programme.desc: We leggen uit hoe ambigrammen je brein voor de gek houden, ontdekken de grootvaderparadox en het vraagstuk rond tijdreizen. Tot slot testen we je gehoor met de Shepard Tone-illusie.

programme.title: Digits S1
programme.desc: Muller neemt de kijkers mee naar de kern van het internet en onthult het allereerste bericht dat werd verzonden door UCLA-professor Leonard Kleinrock. Hij laat zien hoe de ontwikkelaars van het internet, Vint Cerf en Bob Kahn, een gemeenschappelijke programeertaal bedachten.

programme.title: Digits S1
programme.desc: Krijg een kijkje hoe het internet-der-dingen het dagelijks leven gaan domineren. Zoals Edward Snowden provocerend opmerkt: "TV is een medium waar je naar kijkt. Het internet is een medium dat naar jou kijkt terwijl je kijkt."

programme.title: Digits S1
programme.desc: Ontdek hoe het web ons kwetsbaar maakt voor cyberdiefstal en het uitvallen van het internet. Muller laat kijkers kennismaken met "white hat" hackers, de cybercriminaliteitsafdeling van de Amerikaanse geheime dienst en soldaten van West Point.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1
programme.desc: Dave krijgt te maken met een rommelige trein, J.P. zaagt een boom om, Regional Crane tilt een enorme muur en Maxum Crane verplaatst een bank naar een hoog gebouw.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1
programme.desc: Dave staat voor een lastige lift bij een woning, J.P. racet tussen last-minute klussen door, en Brad en Nathan Moore helpen een familie hun droom waar te maken.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1
programme.desc: Nathan vecht tegen harde wind tijdens een grote dakbedekkingsklus, Dave voert een eenvoudige hijsklus uit, J.P. verplaatst een bubbelbad en Dan raakt in de war tijdens de bouw van een brug.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1
programme.desc: Lord Prescott bezoekt de chocoladefabriek van Whitaker om meer te weten te komen over de grootschalige productie van chocolade, van de productielijnen tot het proeven door experts en de rijke geschiedenis van het bedrijf. Daarna gaat hij naar HECK! Sausages in North Yorkshire, waar hij probeert zijn eigen recept te creëren: de Hull banger.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1
programme.sub-title: Wensleydale Cheese and Mowbray Pork Pies
programme.desc: Bij de Wensleydale Creamery voegt Lord Prescott zich bij meester-kaasmakers om het productieproces van de beroemde Yorkshire Wensleydale-kaas te volgen en leert hij onderweg de kunst van het kaasproeven. Zijn volgende stop is Mowbray Pork Pies, waar hij kennismaakt met de razendsnelle wereld van de taartproductie.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1
programme.sub-title: Lea and Perrins Worcestershire Sauce and Soreen's Malt Loaf
programme.desc: In de historische fabriek van Lea & Perrins ontrafelt Lord Prescott het verhaal achter de legendarische Worcestershiresaus, die al sinds 1837 wordt geproduceerd. Daarna reist hij door naar Manchester, waar hij de Soreen-fabriek bezoekt, de thuisbasis van de geliefde malt loaf. Daar draait hij mee op de productielijn en experimenteert hij met een nieuwe smaak.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1
programme.sub-title: Playful Design: Feast for the Eyes
programme.desc: Over de hele wereld vinden we gebouwen die niet door hun monumentaliteit, maar juist door hun speelsheid en creativiteit direct in het oog springen. Hun ontwerp heeft iets bijna verslavends – je wilt ze steeds opnieuw bekijken en ze blijven je boeien.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S3
programme.desc: In deze aflevering leren we Rick O'Shea (Ricochet) kennen, een vriend van Larry. Terry en Larry testen verschillende films waarin kogels worden gemanipuleerd om een geweldig resultaat te behalen. Zij testen scènes uit Skyfall, Suicide Squad, American Ultra en The Bear.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S3
programme.desc: Larry wordt in de donkere, mysterieuze wereld van Terry gezogen omdat Terry 2 scènes uit The Shadow, een film uit 1994 met Alec Baldwin, wil testen. Terry komt erachter of zij een man kunnen redden die is vastgeraakt in cementschoenen en vervolgens proberen zij een onmogelijke test uit te voeren.

programme.title: Ultimate Processes S1
programme.desc: Francesca Chiorando gaat de racebaan op voor een testritje in een van de snelste raceauto's ter wereld; een handgemaakte Prodrive Aston Martin.

programme.title: Ultimate Processes S1
programme.desc: In deze aflevering neemt Francesca Chiorando een kijkje in de grootste tractorfabriek van het VK om te zien hoe zij hun nieuwste tractor op maat bouwen.

programme.title: TechKnow S1
programme.desc: Leer over de wetenschap achter smaak en geur. Ontdek de wereldwijde smaakindustrie en hoe nieuwe smaken en geuren gecreëerd worden.

programme.desc: When a greedy corporation starts evicting families in favor of a very profitable real estate project, RoboCop (Robert John Burke) joins with a renegade band of freedom fighters to save them. But RoboCop must also face a new deadly android!

programme.title: Rollerball (1975)
programme.desc: James Caan stars as a rollerball champ in this fast-hitting, action-packed glimpse into a dystopian future in the year 2018 where a brutal, no-holds-barred sport takes the place of war, and murder is just a part of the game! John Houseman co-stars.

programme.title: Rollerball (2002)
programme.desc: Chris Klein, LL Cool J, and Rebecca Romijn-Stamos star in this high-octane thriller as the hottest team in the brutal sport Rollerball. When they discover the league's owner (Jean Reno) will do anything for ratings, they plan to take down the sport!

programme.title: To Live And Die In L.A.
programme.desc: Federal agent Richard Chance has a score to settle, and he's through playing by the rules. He vows to take down a murderous counterfeiter by any means necessary.

programme.title: Thief
programme.desc: Michael Mann ("Manhunter") directs this stylish, action-packed drama that stars James Caan ("Misery") as a master safe cracker who is planning his last heist for the sake of a woman, Tuesday Weld ("Who'll Stop The Rain?"), and a new life.

programme.title: Ronin
programme.desc: Robert De Niro, Jean Reno and Stellan Skarsgard headline a stellar cast in director John Frankenheimer's action-packed and intelligent spy thriller about a group of for-hire mercenaries out to steal a top-secret briefcase for a mysterious client.

programme.title: Harsh Times
programme.desc: Christian Bale, Freddy Rodriguez and Eva Longoria star in this gritty look at friendship, loyalty and ambition set on the rough streets of South-Central Los Angeles as an ex-Army Ranger (Bale) attempts to come to terms with life after the military.

programme.title: Harsh Times
programme.desc: Christian Bale, Freddy Rodriguez and Eva Longoria star in this gritty look at friendship, loyalty and ambition set on the rough streets of South-Central Los Angeles as an ex-Army Ranger (Bale) attempts to come to terms with life after the military.

programme.title: At Close Range
programme.desc: A farm boy (Sean Penn) looking for excitement finds himself on a collision course with his smooth-talking gang leader father (Christopher Walken) in this "powerfully disturbing" (Newsweek) tale based on the story of real-life killer Bruce Johnston.

programme.title: Kalifornia
programme.desc: A couple (David Duchovny, Michelle Forbes) sets out on a cross-country trip to research a book about serial killers and, along the way, pick up an ex-con and his girlfriend (Brad Pitt, Juliette Lewis) who take them on a ride they'll never forget.

programme.title: American Ninja
programme.desc: Michael Dudikoff stars as Joe Armstrong, a one-man fighting machine. Serving in the army to avoid prison, Joe finds himself battling the deadly Black Star Order, as well as corrupt military leaders in order to bring down an illegal arms sale.

programme.title: American Ninja 2: The Confrontation
programme.desc: In this action-packed sequel, Joe Armstrong and Curtis Jackson are sent to the Caribbean in search of missing Marines. But they must first battle scientifically engineered Super Ninjas to bring down a dreaded drug lord known as The Lion!

programme.title: American Ninja 3: Blood Hunt
programme.desc: Martial artist David Bradley takes the reins as Sean Davidson in this third installment of the wildly popular "American Ninja" franchise, teaming up with Steve James to battle a maniacal terrorist in yet another explosive action-packed adventure!

programme.title: American Ninja 4: The Annihilation
programme.desc: Michael Dudikoff is back in action in this thrilling sequel! Teamed up with CIA operative Sean Davidson (David Bradley), Joe Armstrong (Dudikoff) returns to help foil the plans of a terrorist (James Booth) hell-bent on annihilating New York City.

programme.title: The Man In The Iron Mask
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio leads a phenomenal cast in this thrilling tale of majesty and Musketeers. When the excesses of France's arrogant King Louis XIV begin to threaten his subjects' very lives, the legendary Musketeers reunite to save their country!

programme.title: Rob Roy
programme.desc: Liam Neeson and Jessica Lange give extraordinary performances as the legendary hero who refused to let his enemies destroy his honor and the loyal woman who gave him the courage to fight! Tim Roth, in an Oscar®-nominated performance, also stars.

programme.title: Rolling Thunder
programme.desc: William Devane and Tommy Lee Jones star as two former P.O.W.s out for revenge in this neo-noir action-thriller that Quentin Tarantino cites as one of his favorite films. Written by genre masters Paul Schrader and Heywood Gould. John Flynn directs.

programme.title: No Way Out
programme.desc: Kevin Costner and Gene Hackman star in this taut, political thriller that sees Costner, as Naval Commander Tom Farrell, on the hunt for a very real killer and a very unreal Russian mole, and all the clues lead back to himself. Sean Young co-stars.

programme.title: The Package
programme.desc: Gene Hackman and Tommy Lee Jones headline this explosive action-thriller about Green Beret (Hackman) who uncovers a terrifying military conspiracy when he is tasked with escorting a U.S. soldier (Jones) back to the States for a court martial.

programme.title: Trails to Oishii Tokyo
programme.desc: Bean sprouts are harvested all year and have long been a favorite addition to a healthy diet. All they need is water to grow, so during a food shortage, harsh temperatures, or even after disasters like the Great East Japan Earthquake, bean sprouts are here to save the day. Our reporter, Kyle, visits a farm in Aomori Prefecture that cultivates 40-centimenter-long bean sprouts using hot spring water. Also, feast your eyes on local dishes featuring the produce. programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: No one believes Grandpa Smurf when he tells of far-away jungles and savannahs teeming with wild giant cats, striped horses, long-necked leaf-eaters and strange tribes... Only some Smurflings give some credit to his tales. But when Grandpa Smurf hears the sound of the magic Royal Drum in the forest, the one that can tame wild beasts, he sets out to prove that he's not an old addle-brained storyteller.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfette leads the Smurflings on a nature hike, but Puppy gets too far ahead and they chase him into the land of the Wartmongers. King Bullrush captures them in bubbles and imprisons them. A group of rebels rescue the Smurflings and they escape on the back of Puppy.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.sub-title: A Smurf On The Wild Side, Part I
programme.desc: What, or who, is that strange being in the forest? It looks vaguely like a Smurf, but it chatters away like the squirrel that seems to be accompanying it… And why is Papa Smurf talking about the Lost Smurfling?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Snappy has a new trick: he frightens everybody, or tries to, with his hand-puppet dragon. But it gets, shall we say, out of hand when Papa Smurf's magic liquid falls on the puppet and it comes alive. Alive and kicking, what's more, endangering Snappy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy Smurf is the one who fixes everything that needs mending in the Village of the Smurfs. But are his efforts really appreciated by the other Smurfs? Not at all. At least this is what Handy feels when he resolves to leave the Smurfs Village forever and live in the sea with Marina the Mermaid...

programme.title: Farmer's Genie
programme.desc: As Farmer Smurf says, what's a gourd doing in the melon patch, when it should be by the rutabagas? But when Farmer Smurf pulls the gourd out of the ground he frees a genie, which calls him Master and insists on granting him wishes. The genie, called Gourdy, is going to be more of a hindrance than a help in his eagerness to please Farmer Smurf.

programme.title: Poet's Writers' Block
programme.desc: The Smurfs want a poem written for each of them. The pressure overwhelms Poet, so he runs away seeking inspiration. The Wilybeast King captures Poet and forces him to write a poem to cheer up the King's daughter. Poet learns that motivation must come from the heart and cannot be forced.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Thinking Baby Smurf is a leprechaun, two poachers kidnap him and try to get the small one to tell them where his pot of gold is hidden. Papa Smurf organizes everyone to attack the villains with Smurfberry pies so Baby can escape.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: None of the Smurfs seem to have time to play with the Smurflings. They go on a visit to Father Time and come across the River of Time, the great current that flows along majestically, carrying with it all the time in the world. And then an accident occurs, with untimely consequences...

programme.title: Tailor's Magic Needle
programme.desc: Tailor Smurf has to make an outfit for every Smurf before the Fall fashion show. Brainy Smurf wants to help him and, using Papa Smurf's book of Magic, he conjures up a magic needle that sews ten times faster than tailor... But is it really any good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Selwyn and Tallulah are two powerful married wizards. The trouble is, they fight all the time. But the energy from their arguments is brewing up a dreadful storm and Papa has to get them to make up before the storm starts to rage.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Balthazar brings Denisa to Gargamel to baby-sit. But Gargamel loses Denisa in the wood and she and Sassette meet and become friends. Sassette and Denisa work together to free the Smurfs from Gargamel's stewpot, and prove you don't have to be big to be brave.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Peewit, the court jester, is the Smurfs' human friend. There is to be a celebration at the King's castle and Peewit good-humouredly invites his little blue friends to the feast. But they learn that the wicked chamberlain is pilfering the King's possessions.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: There are few things Grandpa Smurf enjoys more than telling a good scary story, and there are few Smurfs who don't love to listen. But things get a little too much for Brainy Smurf when Grandpa tells of Poltersmurfs, and Poltersmurfs begin harrowing Brainy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The good fairy, Guinilda gives Greedy a magic porridge pot that Brainy causes to overflow into the village and forest. The good-hearted fairy hurries to the rescue and then asks for the pot back to give to an orphanage of hungry children.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: To prove the worth of his Big Book of Wilderness Survival, Brainy takes the Smurflings to the swamp. Where, thanks to his expert advice, the tiny group gets totally lost, is then caught in quicklime and trapped by King Bullrush of the Wartmongers. Fortunately, Bullrush is in a playful mood and devises a Smurf hunt. Unfortunately, Brainy believes he is a born leader...

programme.title: Smurf Box Derby
programme.desc: Handy Smurf makes another invention: the Smurfmobile. Each Smurf has his – or her – customized vehicle and all, or almost all, the Smurfs enjoy a little spin... But then the evil wizard Gargamel gets hold of the idea and starts making trouble for the Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: His wicked cousin, Malcolm the Mean, who plans to kill him and mount him in his trophy room, has turned King Gerard into a black stag. The little Smurfs help their friend. When King Gerard is transformed back into his human form, Malcolm becomes imprisoned in the body of the stag.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In Ancient India, the unscrupulous fakir Gargapuri sells the Smurfs to the Rajah for his private zoo. Only Grandpa, Wild Smurf and Jokey are free, so it's up to them to sneak into the palace and rescue their friends. Along the way they free all the caged animals in the Raja's menagerie.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel creates the legend of Sorcerer Smurf to lure Papa Smurf and his smurfy friends into a trap at his mountain hideaway. Papa Smurf outwits the wicked wizard with some of his own magic and Gargamel is chased down the mountain and back to his castle.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.sub-title: The Smurf Who Would Be King
programme.desc: Dreamy yearns to be King after reading a story about them. He falls through a whirlpool while on his ship and finds himself in the land of pokies who think Dreamy is their long-lost King. When he confronts the pokies' enemies, the Norfnags, he finds they aren't fearful at all. Dreamy bumps his head and wakes up to discover it was just a dream, yet finds a jewel in his cap, just like the ones the pokies mine for a living.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: April Smurf's Day turns out to be not so funny when Gargamel dons a smurfberry bush disguise to capture the happy little Smurfs. Papa Smurf instructs Feathers to call the birds to attack the fake bush. After it is stripped, the captured Smurfs climb aboard Feathers and fly away.

programme.title: Beauty Is Only Smurf Deep
programme.desc: Periwinkle, a vain Pixie, is upset when her magic mirror tells her that Vanity is the fairest, not she. Periwinkle kidnaps Vanity, but the rest of the Smurfs come to Vanity's rescue. Periwinkle sees the error of her ways and they become friends.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: A fierce wind carries the Smurfs' windmill away, with several Smurfs inside. Is Lazy Smurf really at fault or is an injustice being committed? Are the captive Smurfs going to be saved from the volcano's crater? Is Brainy going to smurf up his mouth for a moment?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: When Smurfette meets this gentle old gypsy woman in the forest and receives a swirling multicoloured dress, she's delighted. How could she know that this woman is really the evil wizard Gargamel in disguise, and that there is a terrible spell on the beautiful dress?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel creates the legend of Sorcerer Smurf to lure Papa Smurf and his smurfy friends into a trap at his mountain hideaway. Papa Smurf outwits the wicked wizard with some of his own magic and Gargamel is chased down the mountain and back to his castle.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.sub-title: The Smurf Who Would Be King
programme.desc: Dreamy yearns to be King after reading a story about them. He falls through a whirlpool while on his ship and finds himself in the land of pokies who think Dreamy is their long-lost King. When he confronts the pokies' enemies, the Norfnags, he finds they aren't fearful at all. Dreamy bumps his head and wakes up to discover it was just a dream, yet finds a jewel in his cap, just like the ones the pokies mine for a living.

programme.title: The Gallant Smurf
programme.desc: Queen Felicity will not let her son, Prince Godfrey, marry his sweetheart Pricilla. What she wants as a daughter-in-law is a girl who shows her something she's never seen before. When Hogatha learns of this, and also discovers the existence of Grandpa Smurf, she feels confident that she can surprise the Queen with her capture. Of course, Hogatha must first capture Grandpa Smurf...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: April Smurf's Day turns out to be not so funny when Gargamel dons a smurfberry bush disguise to capture the happy little Smurfs. Papa Smurf instructs Feathers to call the birds to attack the fake bush. After it is stripped, the captured Smurfs climb aboard Feathers and fly away.

programme.title: The Whole Smurf And Nothing But The Smurf
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel is able to capture the Smurfette. Now he is going to give her a truth serum and know all of Papa Smurf' secrets… But then Gargamel makes a big mistake and gives the Smurfette a fib formula!

programme.title: Master Scruple
programme.desc: Farmer Smurf is the reluctant master of a genie named Gourdy, whose enthusiasm for service is somewhat excessive. After yet another incident due to Gourdy's overzealousness, Farmer Smurf says something he shouldn't and Gourdy disappears. And guess who finds him? Well, it's Scruple, apprentice to the evil wizard Gargamel. And who should steal Gourdy from Scruple, if not Gargamel himself?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The rain forest of South America is not a place where Vanity Smurf would like to spend his life. And then he starts dancing madly when he gets jungle fever. His dance will have strange results.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel infects Hefty's heart with hate and then uses the little Smurf as a decoy for the others. Fortunately, Hefty's love overcomes his hate and he helps his little friends escape from Gargamel's clutches.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs are on a paradise Pacific Island. Well, not exactly paradise, since there is a very active volcano, on which a very active Hefty Smurf risks his life as well as Smurfette's!

programme.title: The Colour Smurf
programme.desc: Spectra is the Colour Fairy, the one whose wheel of colours make all the blues, reds, yellows and greens of the world. She is a friend of Painter Smurf, so when he takes the Smurflings to her home in her absence, the Smurflings fool around with the Colour Wheel... and all the colours disappear from the Earth. What's worse, without colours the Colour Fairy cannot live...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Jealous of the attention Vanity Smurf receives when he breaks his toe, Jokey Smurf feigns sickness in hopes of getting recognition. Unfortunately, his ploy turns against him and instead of loving care all he receives is the proverbial pound of curse.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Every time Lazy falls asleep, he is caught in the same recurrent nightmare: he is in the power of Morphio, an evil sorcerer who wants to capture as many sleeping souls as possible. One after another, all the Smurfs are going to fall in Morphio's clutches. All of them? Well, maybe not, if Papa Smurf can help it. And Papa Smurf goes to the Sandman for help...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Spring has the Smurfs all competing for Smurfette's affection and Gargamel decides to put a spell on her to help him capture the Smurfs. Papa Smurf intervenes and with the help of the foolish Azrael he foils the wizard's plans.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Oh, the sad plight of Hefty Smurf! He used to be the strongest and the best trained of all the Smurfs. But since Wild Smurf arrived in the Village, nobody pays attention to Hefty anymore. What can Papa Smurf do?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfs try to avoid contact with humans. But this time, Sassette is happy to be friends with a little witch called Melina, whose spells often end up in disaster. And anyway, are witches really human? At any rate, wizards such as Gargamel are.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfs would make delicious meals for the evil wizard Gargamel if it weren't for two things: they're difficult to catch and they're so tiny. Now, suppose there were a formula to change these bite-size snacks into big, juicy square blue meals... Gargamel has an idea...

programme.title: Smurfiplication
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel creates a magic formula that duplicates everything it touches. And surprise! Suddenly there are six Brainy Smurf! This creates a few interesting situations in the Village... And also at Gargamel's!

programme.title: Poet's Writers' Block
programme.desc: The Smurfs want a poem written for each of them. The pressure overwhelms Poet, so he runs away seeking inspiration. The Wilybeast King captures Poet and forces him to write a poem to cheer up the King's daughter. Poet learns that motivation must come from the heart and cannot be forced.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In Ancient India, the unscrupulous fakir Gargapuri sells the Smurfs to the Rajah for his private zoo. Only Grandpa, Wild Smurf and Jokey are free, so it's up to them to sneak into the palace and rescue their friends. Along the way they free all the caged animals in the Raja's menagerie.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Dreamy's wish of becoming an Astrosmurf comes true when Papa Smurf puts him to sleep, magically transforming the landscape and the Smurfs into a space fantasy. Gargamel keeps a close watch on their antics through his crystal ball, but he too falls victim to Papa Smurf's magic and is sent into a thunderstorm.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.sub-title: Tis The Season To Be Smurfy
programme.desc: This is Wild Smurf's first Christmas, and he's impressed by the decorations in the Village of the Smurfs. But Grandpa and Sassette are going to teach him the real meaning of Christmas when they help an old couple to live the most beautiful Christmas they've ever seen...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Life in the Smurf Village might be more peaceful if Puppy's behavior were a little more considerate. But the little Smurf dog is digging up Smurfette's flowers, dirtying Vanity's new wallpaper or ruining Papa Smurf's experiments. Yet Puppy's going to help the Smurfs out of a trap contrived by Gargamel... Or maybe he won't be disciplined enough...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Where have all the squirrels gone ? Wild Smurf is a little worried. He’d be more worried still if he knew about the ugly witch Hogatha’s dreadful plan for making herself some hair tonic.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Littlest Witch
programme.desc: On an errand to Witch Haven for Papa Smurf, the little blue creatures meet a tiny witch and teach her how to be good while at the same time cause another witch to lose her wicked powers for one year after she falls into the river.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurflings free the Smurfs from the clutches of Gargamel just in time to get Baby to its first word ceremony. Baby utters the word « Gargamel ». Papa Smurf says that this word indicates that Baby will one day become the Great Chief, as he is aware of the dangers in life.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Simon is lost in the forest and in search of his parents. Simon is the son of a couple of giants. The Smurfs try to bring him home, but then Gargamel interrupts the party.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel casts a spell on Papa's new bed so anyone who sleeps in it is transported to the location of his dream. The drowsy Smurfs' fantasies lead them to a private ship, a castle and finally to Gargamel's. They escape when Clumsy falls asleep and dreams of home.

programme.title: Skyscraper Smurfs
programme.desc: Sure, a village of mushroom-shaped houses is nice and jolly... But not very modern, in Architect Smurf's view. What the Smurfs need is smurfdominium, a new, daring concept that will change the art of living forever...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Disaster strikes when Brainy and Baby mix up Papa Smurf's formulas, leaving them powerless before an army of hungry locusts unleashed on the forest by Gargamel.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: As his name implies, Dabbler Smurf is incapable of staying put in any one activity. He goes from one pursuit to another with the greatest of ease and never finishes what he's begun. But suddenly here he is smitten by the love of the medical profession. Dabbler wants to become a doctor and all of the Smurfs, with Papa Smurf in the lead, are going to help him to achieve his wish.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel the evil wizard is in trouble again. If he can't find an enormous amount of gold by sundown, all his possessions will be taken away from him. But the Smurfs are going to help their arch-enemy... Up to a point.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: If there is one thing that the evil sorceress Chlorhydris cannot abide, it is other people's happiness. The spectacle of the Smurfs' gentle and song-filled life gets Chlorhydsis' hackles up. She must destroy that tinkling laughter, smother those happy repartees... She plants the root of evil in the forest and soon, no Smurf is on speaking terms with another. Baby Smurf is the only one untouched...

programme.title: The Gargoyle Of Quarrel Castle
programme.desc: In Quarrel Castle, you almost never hear a kind word. Both Selwyn the Warlock and Tallulah, his witch-mate, spend their time quarrelling. Tharp, their pet gargoyle, takes refuge in the Village of Smurfs. But something terrible is going to happen....

programme.title: Brainy Smurf, Friend To All Animals
programme.desc: Brainy dons his safari hat and roams the forest to do good deeds for animals. He mostly gives advice to the creatures but balks when he can really save the life of a wildcat being hunted by Gargamel. Nat gives Brainy the courage to free the cat from Gargamel's trap.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Clockwork Smurf is feeling so lonely that, out of compassion, Handy Smurf builds a female companion for him. The trouble is, Clockwork Smurfette does not know she's supposed to have eyes only for her mechanical counterpart, or that she should avoid Gargamel....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The wonderful joy of Christmas for Baby Smurf and everyone else is almost ruined by the evil Chlorhydris who puts a spell on Mr. Nicholas to stop him from spreading holiday cheer. Fortunately, Papa Smurf and his little blue creatures break the spell and Christmas spreads over the land once more.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.sub-title: Scruple And The Great Book Of Spells
programme.desc: When Scruple, helper to the evil Gargamel, finds the Great Book of Spells in his master's cellar, he asks for the power to be the world's most powerful wizard. This means trouble for the poor little Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf gives Weakling a special cream to wear that will restore his strength. Shortly after, he is awarded for his daring deeds of strength and his confidence really soars when he realizes the cream is smurfberry jam.

programme.title: Snappy's Way
programme.desc: Did you know that if you catch a troll, he may grant you one wish? It just happens that Aloysius the Troll gets caught in one of Gargamel's Smurf traps. Snappy Smurf sets him free and as a reward, gets to make all other Smurfs obey his every whim. Now this brings a lot of trouble to the Smurfs, as Smurflings, sometimes, ask for things that are not good for them... or anybody else.

programme.title: Don Smurfo
programme.desc: Everyone has their own dreams. That of Smurfette is to meet the legendary Don Smurfo, the dashing, witty, swashbuckling hero of many an engrossing tale. The Smurfs shrug at this infatuation. But when a real-life Don Smurfo appears in the village and Smurfette snubs them all in favor of the bragging stranger, they take the matter a little more seriously.

programme.title: Smurf On The Run
programme.desc: Little things can sometimes bring about big effects. In trying to catch Sassette, Gargamel upsets the Balance of Truth, and from then on everybody in the world tells lies. Even Papa Smurf is changed into a pathological liar. What is more, the Spirit of the Scales chain Gargamel and Sassette to each other, and together they have to replace the Topaz of Truth....

programme.title: Mud-Wrestling Smurfs
programme.desc: The Wartmongers are draining Smurf River to make mud for their wrestling matches. Clumsy, who has been feeling like a loser at sports, becomes a hero when he must wrestle the Mad Maher as a distraction, enabling Papa and Hefty to break into the factory and destroy the mud making machine.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Being kind to animals brings unforeseen results for the Smurfs when they decide to bring a baby dinosaur back home... in its own era! This is the start of a series that spans space and time.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In trying to avoid doing his chores, Lazy Smurf finds an old abandoned well with an interesting peculiarity: anything that goes down in the bucket comes back up in its original brand-new condition. But is it good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs take Grandpa Smurf to the King's castle so that he can meet Peewit. But what with one thing and another (especially another), the Smurfs and Peewit are taken aboard a Viking long ship. The Vikings take Peewit to be their mythical Great Warrior, the one who is going to vanquish the Storm King. Can the Smurfs help Peewit out of his quandary?

programme.title: The Whole Smurf And Nothing But The Smurf
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel is able to capture the Smurfette. Now he is going to give her a truth serum and know all of Papa Smurf' secrets… But then Gargamel makes a big mistake and gives the Smurfette a fib formula!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: It's been a few hundred years since Grandpa Smurf has seen this old toy… It was given to Papa Smurf long, long ago and he does not remember what it does. But Baby Smurf does know that it brings surprises for everyone!

programme.title: He Who Smurfs Last
programme.desc: Jokey's practical jokes go too far when Chlorhydris is the victim of one. She gets her revenge on the Smurfs by creating a spell to steal their sense of humor. Grouchy, who had no sense of humor to begin with, breaks the spell by getting back the humor potion.

programme.title: Jokey's Medecine
programme.desc: Because of Jokey's pranks, none of the Smurfs believe him when he tells them that Azrael the cat is ready to pounce on them. Feeling guilty and responsible, he hurries to Gargamel's castle and plays some explosive jokes on the wizard and his cat so he can free his friends.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: No one believes Grandpa Smurf when he tells of far-away jungles and savannahs teeming with wild giant cats, striped horses, long-necked leaf-eaters and strange tribes... Only some Smurflings give some credit to his tales. But when Grandpa Smurf hears the sound of the magic Royal Drum in the forest, the one that can tame wild beasts, he sets out to prove that he's not an old addle-brained storyteller.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Smurfette leads the Smurflings on a nature hike, but Puppy gets too far ahead and they chase him into the land of the Wartmongers. King Bullrush captures them in bubbles and imprisons them. A group of rebels rescue the Smurflings and they escape on the back of Puppy.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.sub-title: A Smurf On The Wild Side, Part I
programme.desc: What, or who, is that strange being in the forest? It looks vaguely like a Smurf, but it chatters away like the squirrel that seems to be accompanying it… And why is Papa Smurf talking about the Lost Smurfling?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Snappy has a new trick: he frightens everybody, or tries to, with his hand-puppet dragon. But it gets, shall we say, out of hand when Papa Smurf's magic liquid falls on the puppet and it comes alive. Alive and kicking, what's more, endangering Snappy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy Smurf is the one who fixes everything that needs mending in the Village of the Smurfs. But are his efforts really appreciated by the other Smurfs? Not at all. At least this is what Handy feels when he resolves to leave the Smurfs Village forever and live in the sea with Marina the Mermaid...

programme.title: Farmer's Genie
programme.desc: As Farmer Smurf says, what's a gourd doing in the melon patch, when it should be by the rutabagas? But when Farmer Smurf pulls the gourd out of the ground he frees a genie, which calls him Master and insists on granting him wishes. The genie, called Gourdy, is going to be more of a hindrance than a help in his eagerness to please Farmer Smurf.

programme.title: Poet's Writers' Block
programme.desc: The Smurfs want a poem written for each of them. The pressure overwhelms Poet, so he runs away seeking inspiration. The Wilybeast King captures Poet and forces him to write a poem to cheer up the King's daughter. Poet learns that motivation must come from the heart and cannot be forced.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Thinking Baby Smurf is a leprechaun, two poachers kidnap him and try to get the small one to tell them where his pot of gold is hidden. Papa Smurf organizes everyone to attack the villains with Smurfberry pies so Baby can escape.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: None of the Smurfs seem to have time to play with the Smurflings. They go on a visit to Father Time and come across the River of Time, the great current that flows along majestically, carrying with it all the time in the world. And then an accident occurs, with untimely consequences...

programme.title: Tailor's Magic Needle
programme.desc: Tailor Smurf has to make an outfit for every Smurf before the Fall fashion show. Brainy Smurf wants to help him and, using Papa Smurf's book of Magic, he conjures up a magic needle that sews ten times faster than tailor... But is it really any good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Selwyn and Tallulah are two powerful married wizards. The trouble is, they fight all the time. But the energy from their arguments is brewing up a dreadful storm and Papa has to get them to make up before the storm starts to rage.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Balthazar brings Denisa to Gargamel to baby-sit. But Gargamel loses Denisa in the wood and she and Sassette meet and become friends. Sassette and Denisa work together to free the Smurfs from Gargamel's stewpot, and prove you don't have to be big to be brave.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Peewit, the court jester, is the Smurfs' human friend. There is to be a celebration at the King's castle and Peewit good-humouredly invites his little blue friends to the feast. But they learn that the wicked chamberlain is pilfering the King's possessions.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: There are few things Grandpa Smurf enjoys more than telling a good scary story, and there are few Smurfs who don't love to listen. But things get a little too much for Brainy Smurf when Grandpa tells of Poltersmurfs, and Poltersmurfs begin harrowing Brainy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The good fairy, Guinilda gives Greedy a magic porridge pot that Brainy causes to overflow into the village and forest. The good-hearted fairy hurries to the rescue and then asks for the pot back to give to an orphanage of hungry children.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: To prove the worth of his Big Book of Wilderness Survival, Brainy takes the Smurflings to the swamp. Where, thanks to his expert advice, the tiny group gets totally lost, is then caught in quicklime and trapped by King Bullrush of the Wartmongers. Fortunately, Bullrush is in a playful mood and devises a Smurf hunt. Unfortunately, Brainy believes he is a born leader...

programme.title: Smurf Box Derby
programme.desc: Handy Smurf makes another invention: the Smurfmobile. Each Smurf has his – or her – customized vehicle and all, or almost all, the Smurfs enjoy a little spin... But then the evil wizard Gargamel gets hold of the idea and starts making trouble for the Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: His wicked cousin, Malcolm the Mean, who plans to kill him and mount him in his trophy room, has turned King Gerard into a black stag. The little Smurfs help their friend. When King Gerard is transformed back into his human form, Malcolm becomes imprisoned in the body of the stag.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In Ancient India, the unscrupulous fakir Gargapuri sells the Smurfs to the Rajah for his private zoo. Only Grandpa, Wild Smurf and Jokey are free, so it's up to them to sneak into the palace and rescue their friends. Along the way they free all the caged animals in the Raja's menagerie.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel creates the legend of Sorcerer Smurf to lure Papa Smurf and his smurfy friends into a trap at his mountain hideaway. Papa Smurf outwits the wicked wizard with some of his own magic and Gargamel is chased down the mountain and back to his castle.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.sub-title: The Smurf Who Would Be King
programme.desc: Dreamy yearns to be King after reading a story about them. He falls through a whirlpool while on his ship and finds himself in the land of pokies who think Dreamy is their long-lost King. When he confronts the pokies' enemies, the Norfnags, he finds they aren't fearful at all. Dreamy bumps his head and wakes up to discover it was just a dream, yet finds a jewel in his cap, just like the ones the pokies mine for a living.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: April Smurf's Day turns out to be not so funny when Gargamel dons a smurfberry bush disguise to capture the happy little Smurfs. Papa Smurf instructs Feathers to call the birds to attack the fake bush. After it is stripped, the captured Smurfs climb aboard Feathers and fly away.

programme.title: Beauty Is Only Smurf Deep
programme.desc: Periwinkle, a vain Pixie, is upset when her magic mirror tells her that Vanity is the fairest, not she. Periwinkle kidnaps Vanity, but the rest of the Smurfs come to Vanity's rescue. Periwinkle sees the error of her ways and they become friends.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: A fierce wind carries the Smurfs' windmill away, with several Smurfs inside. Is Lazy Smurf really at fault or is an injustice being committed? Are the captive Smurfs going to be saved from the volcano's crater? Is Brainy going to smurf up his mouth for a moment?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: When Smurfette meets this gentle old gypsy woman in the forest and receives a swirling multicoloured dress, she's delighted. How could she know that this woman is really the evil wizard Gargamel in disguise, and that there is a terrible spell on the beautiful dress?

programme.desc: Gargamel creates the legend of Sorcerer Smurf to lure Papa Smurf and his smurfy friends into a trap at his mountain hideaway. Papa Smurf outwits the wicked wizard with some of his own magic and Gargamel is chased down the mountain and back to his castle.

programme.title: The Gallant Smurf
programme.desc: Queen Felicity will not let her son, Prince Godfrey, marry his sweetheart Pricilla. What she wants as a daughter-in-law is a girl who shows her something she's never seen before. When Hogatha learns of this, and also discovers the existence of Grandpa Smurf, she feels confident that she can surprise the Queen with her capture. Of course, Hogatha must first capture Grandpa Smurf...
